title: Remove the second Git filter-driver lookup from source observations
outcome: After the shared Git-delta source identity lands, remove the redundant filter-driver lookup, its dedicated test, and its contract text
acceptance: The shared source producer discovers and neutralizes configured Git filter drivers once for each observed repository, before reading the worktree.

The post-read filter-driver lookup, the test for an intervening configuration write, and its development contract text are removed. Source observations continue to refuse partial Git reads reported on stderr.
disposal_reason: Fable #2673 supersedes #2671 on Greg’s instruction and folds this exact staged change into D895 R14 before landing. Separate follow-up duplicates the active work.
